E2.form: two LLM lanes: one authors a repair to the endpoint ledger anchor, one cross-checks it; the deterministic verifier decides

E3.form: three LLM lanes may author repairs to the endpoint ledger anchor and cross-check each other's diffs; the deterministic verifier alone decides the verdict
